strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Optimise capital efficiency, reduce leverage further and improve operational margins
- For FY 2026-27, emphasise timely project execution and disciplined cost control
- Leverage continued premiumisation trends in residential demand
- Continue executing the real estate development strategy while strengthening the financial position
- Pursue growth through strategic partnerships and joint development projects, including the slum rehabilitation joint development with a group company
- Remain watchful of input cost inflation and global trade-policy uncertainty
